77534709.title: Alma Cooper
77534709.extract: Alma Oralia Minerva Cooper (born March 17, 2002) is an American beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss USA 2024. Cooper represented the United States at the Miss Universe 2024 pageant where she did not place.

1991791.title: Angelique Boyer
1991791.extract: Angelique Monique-Paulette Boyer Rousseau (born 4 July 1988), simply known as Angelique Boyer, is a Mexican actress. Among her most notable works is her participation in soap operas such as Rebelde, and Teresa.

2190438.title: Ashley Tisdale
2190438.extract: Ashley Michelle Tisdale-French (born July 2, 1985) is an American actress and singer. During her childhood, she was featured in over 100 advertisements and had minor roles on-screen and in theatre.

79106199.title: Camilla Ghini
79106199.extract: Camilla Ghini (born 22 March 1994) is an Italian television presenter, radio personality and model.

77531682.title: Chidimma Adetshina
77531682.extract: Chidimma Vanessa Onwe Adetshina (born 8 January 2001) is a Nigerian South African beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss Universe Nigeria 2024. She represented Nigeria at the Miss Universe 2024 pageant in Mexico and finished as the first runner-up.

38450658.title: Cristina Del Basso
38450658.extract: Cristina Del Basso (born 3 May 1987) is an Italian model, showgirl and actress.

77258566.title: Debbii Dawson
77258566.extract: Deborah Dawson, known by her stage name Debbii Dawson, is an American singer, songwriter, and producer. Known for her blend of pop, folk, and country music, she appeared on America's Got Talent in 2022 and signed with RCA Records in 2024.

23733398.title: Esmeralda Pimentel
23733398.extract:
Esmeralda Pimentel (née Maria Esmeralda Pimentel on September 8, 1989) is a Mexican actress and model.
She began her media career in 2009, appearing in commercials and television promotions.

56603354.title: Hanis Zalikha
56603354.extract: Hanis Zalikha Zainal Rashid (born 9 October 1990) is a Malaysian model, actress, television host, entrepreneur, and blogger. She has also been nominated for the Most Influential Blog Award in 2011.

81197304.title: Leah Halton
81197304.extract: Leah Lucia Halton (born January 6, 2001) is an Australian social media influencer and model. She is best known as the "Queen of Coachella" and rose to prominence after she went viral for a lip-sync video to YG Marley's popular song "Praise Jah in the Moonlight".

39313585.title: Lotta Hintsa
39313585.extract: Lotta Henriikka Hintsa (known as Lotta Näkyvä from 2016 to 2019, born 14 December 1988) is a Finnish model, mountaineer and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Finland 2013 and represented her country at Miss Universe 2013.

77307661.title: María Alejandra Camargo
77307661.extract: María Alejandra Camargo Jiménez (born September 24, 1997) is a Colombian model, architect and beauty pageant titleholder who was selected Miss Earth Colombia 2024, she represented Colombia at Miss Earth 2024.

24098464.title: María Gabriela de Faría
24098464.extract: María Gabriela de Faría Chacón (born 11 September 1992) is a Venezuelan actress known for her work in South American television series. Appearing most frequently in Nickelodeon shows, de Faria has starred as Isabela "Isa" Pasquali in Isa TKM, as Mia Novoa in Grachi, and as Franky Andrade in Yo soy Franky.

40436497.title: Neelofa
40436497.extract: Noor Neelofa Mohd Noor (born 10 February 1989) is a Malaysian actress, television presenter, commercial model and entrepreneur. She rose to fame when participated in a drama queen competition, Dewi Remaja, winning the Dewi Remaja 2009/10 title organised by the Malaysian teen magazine, Remaja.

77178554.title: Preity Mukhundhan
77178554.extract: Preity Mukhundhan is an Indian actress, model and dancer who works predominantly in Tamil, Malayalam, and Telugu films. After appearing in music videos including "Aasa Kooda" (2024), she made her film debut with Om Bheem Bush (2024) and gained wider recognition for her role in Star (2024).

77610194.title: Rachel Gupta
77610194.extract: Rachel Gupta (born 23 January 2004) is an Indian model and beauty pageant titleholder who was crowned Miss Grand International 2024, the first Indian to win Miss Grand International. Her reign concluded in May 2025 prematurely after her internal issues with the organization.

77619731.title: Rio Fredrika
77619731.extract: Rio Fredrika Debolla (born 3 July 1995) is an English radio and television presenter, DJ, and former model. She began her career in modeling before going into presenting.

57967415.title: Stanija Dobrojević
57967415.extract: Stanija Dobrojević (born 17 March 1985) is a Serbian glamour model, reality television personality and former recording artist.

78378275.title: Suchata Chuangsri
78378275.extract: Suchata Chuangsri (born 20 September 2003) also known by the Thai nickname Opal is a Thai beauty pageant titleholder who won Miss World 2025. She is the first Thai woman to win Miss World.

48590169.title: Yasemin Allen
48590169.extract: Yasemin Kay Allen (born 10 July 1989) is a British-Turkish actress.
